officialInventory.summary: The national conservation-area network is managed by INBAC (Instituto Nacional da Biodiversidade e Áreas de Conservação, under the ministry responsible for the environment, currently the Ministério da Cultura, Turismo e Ambiente per INBAC park pages). INBAC's website lists 14 areas — 9 national parks, 1 regional natural park (Chimalavera) and 4 reserves — with creating instruments and areas on each page; this matches the counts in the 2019-2025 NBSAP and INBAC's November 2023 status report (156,909.9 km2, 12.58% of the territory). No machine-readable register exists. The legal framework is Lei 8/20 (Áreas de Conservação Ambiental), amended by Lei 12/21. Four further areas, including the first marine conservation area (Baía dos Tigres), are being created but no creating instrument was found.

areas.name: Iona National Park

legalStatus.text: Game park by Portaria 2421 of 2/10/1937; game reserve by Portaria 4880 of 6/9/1944; elevated to Parque Nacional de Porto Alexandre by Diploma Legislativo 2873 of 11/12/1957; renamed Iona with new limits by Diploma Legislativo 3524 of 26/12/1964; 90 km2 excised by Portaria 516 of 17/8/1973

areas.notes: INBAC: lies between the Atlantic and the Cunene and Curoca rivers with ~150 km of coastline; DP 88/23 lists it as one of three terrestrial areas bordered by the ocean. Forms the Iona-Skeleton Coast Transfrontier Park with Namibia. First protected 1937.

areas.name: Quiçama National Park

legalStatus.text: Game reserve by Portaria 2620 of 16/4/1938; elevated to Parque Nacional by Diploma Legislativo 2873 of 11/12/1957 (B.O. I Série n.º 50)

areas.notes: Also spelled Kissama/Quissama. INBAC: ~120 km of Atlantic coastline between the Kwanza and Longa river mouths; DP 88/23 lists it as bordered by the ocean. The 2025 presidential announcement mentions a planned biosphere reserve 'do Parque Nacional da Quiçama ao mar' (not designated).

legalStatus.text: Game reserve (Portaria number/date blank on INBAC page); elevated to Parque Nacional by Diploma Legislativo 2873 of 11/12/1957

areas.name: Bicuar National Park

legalStatus.text: Game reserve by Portaria 2620 of 16/4/1938; elevated by Diploma Legislativo 3527 of 26/12/1964 (INBAC park page says to 'Reserva parcial'; the INBAC 2023 report says to Parque Nacional)

areas.notes: Huíla province. INBAC summary: game reserve 1938, partial reserve 1957, national park 1964, current limits defined 1972.

areas.name: Mupa National Park

legalStatus.text: Game reserve by Portaria 2620 of 16/4/1938; elevated to park by Diploma Legislativo 3527 of 26/12/1964 (B.O. I Série n.º 52)

areas.notes: Cunene province. The INBAC park page text mistakenly says it was elevated to 'Reserva natural integral de Bicuar'.

legalStatus.text: Game reserve by Portaria 3740 (25 May, year not given); elevated to Parque Nacional by Diploma Legislativo 4017 of June 1970

areas.name: Luengue-Luiana National Park

legalStatus.text: Created by Lei n.º 38/11 de 29 de Dezembro (Diário da República I Série n.º 251), covering the former Reserva Parcial de Luiana and parts of the Longa-Mavinga, Luengue, Luiana and Mucusso public hunting areas

areas.notes: Area conflict: Lei 38/11 art. 4 gives approx. 22,610 km2; INBAC gives 45,816 km2 (park page) / 45,818 km2 (report). Cuando Cubango; part of KAZA TFCA. Former partial reserve from 1966 (INBAC).

areas.name: Mavinga National Park

legalStatus.text: Created by Lei n.º 38/11 de 29 de Dezembro; previously Reserva Parcial by Diploma Legislativo 3677 of 17/9/1966

areas.notes: Cuando Cubango; part of KAZA TFCA.

areas.name: Maiombe National Park

legalStatus.text: Created by Lei n.º 38/11 de 29 de Dezembro (as 'Parque Nacional do Mayombe'); INBAC pages call it 'decreto nº 38/11'

areas.notes: Also spelled Mayombe; Cabinda province; part of the Mayombe transboundary initiative.

areas.name: Chimalavera Regional Natural Park

legalStatus.text: Established as a reserve by Diploma Legislativo 4124 of May 1971; INBAC also cites '352 de 15.04.1974 (B.O. I série nº 88)'

areas.notes: Benguela province, 24 km from Benguela city.

areas.name: Luando Integral Nature Reserve

legalStatus.text: Proclaimed a game reserve in 1938 and raised to Reserva Natural Integral in 1955 (instruments not named by INBAC)

areas.notes: Habitat of the giant sable. Area 8,280 km2 per the INBAC 2023 report.

areas.name: Namibe Partial Reserve

legalStatus.text: Created by Diploma Legislativo of 12/6/1957 (B.O. I Série n.º 24) for a limited period to 31/12/1959, maintained with altered limits by Diploma Legislativo 3060 of 24/8/1960

areas.notes: DP 88/23 calls it 'Reserva Natural do Namibe (estabelecida aos 12 de Junho de 1957)' and lists it among three conservation areas with the Atlantic as western limit. INBAC: functions as a buffer for Iona NP. INBAC lists no later renewal after the 1960 extension.

areas.name: Búfalo Partial Reserve

legalStatus.text: Established as Reserva Parcial by Diploma Legislativo 325 of 5/4/1971 (B.O. I série n.º 81) (INBAC report; the INBAC list page truncates the date to '5/4/7')

areas.notes: Namibe province; protects forest buffalo (pacaça); patrolled by Iona NP staff.

areas.name: Ilhéu dos Pássaros Integral Nature Reserve
areas.localName: Reserva Natural Integral do Ilhéu dos Pássaros

legalStatus.text: Created by Decreto Provincial n.º 55 of 21/12/1973 (B.O. I Série n.º 297)

areas.notes: Mussulo bay, Belas municipality, Luanda. INBAC gives 1.7 km2 surface but also 'área estimada em 152 Km2' for the bounding lat/long box; 1.7 used here. Protects waterbirds.

areas.name: Cumbira Forest (proposed conservation area)
areas.designationLabel: Nova área de conservação ambiental (em criação)
areas.notes: INBAC (Nov 2023): 'Angola, está a criar 4 novas áreas de conservação ambiental de âmbito nacional'. Not legally designated as of the sources found. Cuanza Sul province.

areas.name: Morro do Moco (proposed conservation area)
areas.designationLabel: Nova área de conservação ambiental (em criação)
areas.notes: INBAC (Nov 2023): 'Angola, está a criar 4 novas áreas de conservação ambiental de âmbito nacional'. Not legally designated as of the sources found. Huambo province. The INBAC report gives '250.812,15 Km2', which cannot be correct for a mountain massif (larger than the stated total of new areas allows); area left null.

areas.name: Serra do Pingano (proposed conservation area)
areas.designationLabel: Nova área de conservação ambiental (em criação)
areas.notes: INBAC (Nov 2023): 'Angola, está a criar 4 novas áreas de conservação ambiental de âmbito nacional'. Not legally designated as of the sources found. Uíge province.

areas.name: Baía dos Tigres Marine Conservation Area (proposed)
areas.localName: Área de Conservação Marinha da Baía dos Tigres
areas.designationLabel: Nova área de conservação ambiental (em criação)
areas.notes: INBAC (Nov 2023): 'Angola, está a criar 4 novas áreas de conservação ambiental de âmbito nacional'. Not legally designated as of the sources found. Namibe province. Would be Angola's first marine conservation area: DP 88/23 states 'Actualmente Angola não possui áreas de conservação marinhas'; the President announced in Jan 2025 that it would be created that year, and in Oct 2026 still referred to 'o avanço para a criação' — no creating instrument found.

notEnumerated.reason: Hunting concessions, not conservation areas under Lei 8/20; no official current list found (Lei 38/11 names Longa-Mavinga, Luengue, Luiana and Mucusso coutadas partly absorbed into Luengue-Luiana).

gaps: INBAC pages contain copy-paste errors (Mupa page cites 'Reserva natural integral de Bicuar'; Bicuar page says the 1964 diploma created a 'Reserva parcial'; Cameia's Portaria number and date are blank) — legal histories should be checked against the original Boletim Oficial texts, which were not available online.
Luengue-Luiana area conflicts: 22,610 km2 in Lei 38/11 vs 45,816/45,818 km2 in INBAC documents (possibly reflecting later boundary changes not found).
INBAC's conservation-areas document (ago-inbac-acs) highlights an extension of Iona's limits into the marine environment; no instrument confirming a marine extension was found.

Status of the four areas 'em criação' (Cumbira, Morro do Moco, Serra do Pingano, Baía dos Tigres) after November 2023 could not be confirmed from a Diário da República text; as of the October 2026 State of the Nation report Baía dos Tigres was still being advanced.
Lei 8/20 was only available as a scanned PDF (checked by OCR); it defines categories but does not itself list the existing areas.
No official coordinates were used; points depend on Wikidata matches. Chimalavera and Ilhéu dos Pássaros had no matching Wikidata item in a keyword search (Wikidata was rate-limited during this run).
